transcript.t: My hometown has changed a great deal in the last twenty years. When my father was a boy, there was only a narrow road, and it took three hours to reach the city.
Now there is a wide highway and a tunnel through the mountain, so the trip takes only forty minutes.
A new railway also links our town to the capital, and many visitors come to see our beautiful lakes.
Many villagers have moved into new housing, and the old houses are now a small museum.
My grandmother says our town has seen a miracle. I think she is right.
